name: LibreDB Studio
description: LibreDB Studio is an open-source (MIT), self-hosted SQL IDE. It provides a modern web-based interface to connect to forty-one database engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, Db2, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, ClickHouse, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Apache Kafka, Neo4j, Qdrant, Milvus, InfluxDB, etcd and more), browse schemas, and write and run queries from any browser on your LAN. Some are read-only because their own SQL is. Druid, Elasticsearch and OpenSearch have no `UPDATE` and no `CREATE TABLE` at all. Several more are read-only by construction. Data is stored locally in a SQLite database, so everything stays under your control.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  libredb-studio:
    image: libredb/libredb-studio:1.0.0
    container_name: libredb-studio
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    environment:
      ADMIN_EMAIL: admin@libredb.org
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ""
      JWT_SECRET: ""
      STORAGE_PROVIDER: sqlite
      STORAGE_SQLITE_PATH: /app/data/libredb-storage.db
      AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE: "false"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /app/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - node
        - -e
        - "require('http').get('http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/db/health',r=>process.exit(r.statusCode===200?0:1)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 40s
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
    network_mode: bridge
    privileged: false
